biscuit.reason: Real-hardware host-mode, CDC-ECM, DHCP, link-loss, and USB-serial restoration are implemented.

radar.reason: Radar has no external USB port; power, enumeration, and recovery must be qualified with the internal pads and a powered adapter.

checkers.reason: Publish and boot a Tater-built baseline, then qualify board-specific role control, VBUS, enumeration, and serial recovery.

crown.reason: Crown has its own configuration and device tree; publish its baseline and qualify it independently of Checkers.

athena.reason: The current device tree forces peripheral mode and disables the host controller; OTG role switching and VBUS drive require kernel and device-tree work.

rook.reason: Publish and boot a Tater-built baseline, then qualify external usb0 without disturbing the separate usb1 Wi-Fi bus.
